changePolicy: Frozen business rules may only change through an explicit specification change and corresponding golden tests.
architecture: Presentation -> Application -> Domain -> Repository Contracts -> Infrastructure -> Local Database -> Future Integrations
frozenRules: Vehicle lifecycle history includes activation, sale, retirement, acquisition/sale data, status and odometer endpoints.
Work sessions support business/personal scope and break handling without mixing personal use into business profitability.

Every Work lifecycle transition is represented by an authoritative timestamped operational event. GPS evidence is supplementary: capture it when available, resolve a human-readable place name when possible, retain coordinates as fallback, and never block the Work save. Unavailable GPS/place resolution is recorded explicitly; locations are never guessed.
Personal vehicle use is excluded from business dashboard calculations for fuel, maintenance, revenue and profit.
Fixed expenses are business-level obligations and continue across active calendar days, including personal-only and non-working days.
Loan EMI is a continuing business obligation and is not reduced by personal-use days.
Maintenance is a business expense and must support usage-based allocation/provisioning for meaningful cost/km and break-even calculations.
Maintenance records support ID, date, vehicle, odometer, category, description, amount, optional receipt/reference, optional work-session ID and soft deletion.
Loan amortization separates principal and interest and supports prepayment with zero prepayment charges.
Tax Reserve is permanently excluded unless the specification explicitly restores it.
Financial currency values use safe integer paise at persistence/domain monetary boundaries.
Today's implementation must preserve extension points for future multi-vehicle/fleet and integration capabilities without implementing those capabilities now.
deploymentRule: Deployment is permitted only when every mandatory governance and existing validation gate passes.

invariants.rule: Every governance operation MUST begin by resolving repository, target branch, PR number, exact PR HEAD SHA, workflow commit SHA, and latest CI run SHA. A result from any other SHA MUST NOT be used as evidence for the current implementation.
invariants.onMismatch: STOP; classify as STATE_MISMATCH; refresh repository state; do not modify application code; do not modify tests; do not declare PASS; do not deploy.
invariants.deploymentEffect: No stale CI result may authorize a merge or deployment.

invariants.rule: After ANY governance or implementation change, the new PR HEAD SHA and the CI validation code SHA MUST be resolved and compared before any result is accepted.
invariants.onMismatch: STOP; classify as STATE_MISMATCH; do not diagnose using the stale run; do not make another implementation change; do not declare PASS; do not deploy.

stateGovernance.freshnessRule: CI evidence is valid only for the exact repository revision that the gate inspected.
stateGovernance.staleLoopPrevention: Never iterate on a stale failure. Re-resolve repository, branch, HEAD SHA, workflow revision and CI run before each governance diagnosis or repair.
